title: Rain screensaver
tagline: Raindrops ripple across a quiet window.
teaser: Drops land and spread outward in rings, one after another. Put it on and breathe out.

manPage.synopsis: rain — watch raindrops ripple; nothing else required.
manPage.description: Eric P. Scott’s rain drew expanding rings of characters to look like drops on a pond; its notes said it looked best at 9600 baud. This one needs no modem.

howToPlay: Start the rain and watch the drops land.
Each drop spreads into rings on the water.
Leave it on as a calm window in the corner.
